# N22: Watching, the Wrap-up, the Goal map and Feedback switched off: no menu row, tab, layout, button or Help article of theirs, and each comes back on

A check of the Feedback module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)): not a journey with steps a person takes, but a script that opens pages and reports what is wrong (Faro’s `evals/notes/22-more-switches.cjs`). A rebuild proves the same by hand or with its own script: every failure below must not happen. Each is in the script’s words; {…} is what it measured, and a limit its words don’t give is added after it, in the script’s test (“its test: …”).

## What it checks

the four switches SW1 adds (docs/design/feature-switches/spec.md sections 3, 4 and 9; module map, "Designed, not built"). As Amara, an admin, on a computer: with Watching, the Wrap-up, the Goal map and Feedback switched off, every door that is a screen is shut: the menu's last group is Workspace, Settings, Help; Goals has no Watching tab and no Map; a link to the Map opens the List and says so once; Home has no “Goals you watch” and Getting started no “Watch the goals you care about”; a goal's page has no Watch and no “Watched by”; Help lists none of their articles and each article's address says the feature is off; the Features page shows them under their groups with “Off” beside each switch. Then every one back on, and each door opens again. The AI tools' refusals and the actions' are unit tests (each module’s tools.test.ts, src/app/actions.test.ts).

## Where it looks

- 1440 × 900, as amara, at `/workspace/features`

A width of 390 is a phone, 1440 (or 1280) a desktop; the address is in the demo on Thursday 5 November 2026 unless it names another day. {…} is a value the script works out as it runs.
